scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,orch,dest,wx,bud,hr -c blue,magenta,green,yellow,cyan,red "npm run dev -w @travel/web" "npm run dev -w @travel/orchestrator" "npm run dev -w @travel/agent-destination" "npm run dev -w @travel/agent-weather" "npm run dev -w @travel/agent-budget" "npm run dev -w @travel/agent-hr"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @travel/web
scripts.db:seed: npm run seed -w @travel/agent-budget && npm run seed -w @travel/agent-hr
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n web,orch,dest,wx,bud,hr "npm run start -w @travel/web" "npm run start -w @travel/orchestrator" "npm run start -w @travel/agent-destination" "npm run start -w @travel/agent-weather" "npm run start -w @travel/agent-budget" "npm run start -w @travel/agent-hr"
